metadata.dataset_attribution: Carinthia-S public SEM defect dataset (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.16895427, CC BY 4.0, single production layer of unstructured wafers)
metadata.primary_ground_truth_rule: mask >= 128 with right border artifact (x >= 477) zeroed out
metadata.secondary_ground_truth_rule: mask > 0 with right border artifact (x >= 477) zeroed out

rare_holdout_loo_index.description: Leave-One-Out (LOO) candidate pool for sample i is all_rare_ids excluding sample i. Same-class candidate pool is all IDs of same class excluding sample i. Stratified 5-fold CV fold index (0..4) is precomputed on each sample.
